At some point between [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Vor'en Kurn]], [[Deel Surool]], and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]] to [[Mission to Puloorn|investigate]] rumors of a '''Sith temple''' on the small, snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Puloorn]]. Although surveys showed no signs of habitation, the team found the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] temple ruins, possibly inhabited by [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] beasts or cultists, and reported the findings to Palpatine and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].
